coverage: No-registration inspection returns full uint256 native balances, exact code facts and honest no-code commentary without claiming an EOA or account identity.
Pool compatibility takes precedence over overlapping token getters; supply, account balance and pool values come only from bounded fixed selectors.

Revert, short/long/65536-byte returndata, return bombs, gas burn, dirty addresses, reserve/timestamp overflow, uint128 overflow and inconsistent balances produce explicit failures, cleared values and no watch insertion.
Any caller can watch a validated code-pinned key; new watches atomically record a baseline, shared joins and idempotent joins do not resample or overwrite history.
Each wallet is capped at64 watches; filling one wallet does not prevent another from creating a65th global subject; unwatch frees only the caller slot and preserves shared history.
Existing-key joins revalidate getter reads, original pool metadata and runtime code; failures reject joins without overwriting shared history.
Minimum spacing, ring16 retained identities, signed BPS and freshness remain correct after automatic watch baselines.
An actual underfunded local snapshot transaction reverts without poisoning status/history; static ancestry blocks callbacks and writes to an unguarded target.

Reports preserve exact raw facts, classifier labels/scores, ABI feature commitments, snapshot/model identity and local EVM provenance; duplicates/stale inputs reject and failed inference atomically rolls back capture.
A proxy upgrade can change getter behavior while runtime hash remains unchanged; the test demonstrates this caveat rather than claiming implementation pinning.

coverage: Any zero/no-code address returns exact full uint256 native facts and local observation provenance without asserting wallet identity or safety.

PUSH payloads are skipped; PUSH4 candidates deduplicate, truncated instructions do not invent candidates, only32 candidates are stored, candidates beyond4096 are excluded while all-prefix PUSH4/opcode counts continue.
A bounded-prefix scan explicitly reports incomplete runtime coverage; the original31-unique/repeated31st-selector adversary succeeds under an explicit31M transaction gas cap.

ERC165 requires canonical true for the standard and canonical false for0xffffffff; always-true, malformed, failed and noncanonical probes are rejected, including a35k-gas responder that exceeds the30k standard probe.
ERC721, ERC1155 and ERC2981 flags remain separately derived from reported interface support; getters are not treated as asset authenticity or safety certification.
Owner, paused, implementation and asset facts require canonical exact-size values; dirty address words, paused2, short/long/huge data, reverts and gas burns remain unavailable.
Generic reads preserve success/failure and full returndata size while copying at most2048 bytes, reject calldata beyond4096, bound target gas and prohibit value transfers.
Direct and nested writes remain impossible under STATICCALL, including when a reader call is submitted as an actual local transaction.

limits: All deployments and transactions in these tests are local Ganache fixtures; this report does not claim public deployment, signed-wallet browser QA or mainnet gas measurements.

Gas figures include local transaction intrinsic gas and apply to the named fixtures. The9.28M selector regression measurement is not a maximum over every possible runtime; other bytecode patterns can cost more.

Runtime code hashes do not pin a proxy implementation. Getter compatibility and structural signals can be spoofed and do not establish identity, source semantics, asset authenticity, security or future outcomes.
Ganache local EVM block counters agree with its RPC blocks; this does not generalize to Nitro ancestor estimates or BLOCKHASH outputs.
